schema.text: When you walk, does unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders or pedestrians make you feel unsafe?

ar.#When you walk, does unsafe behaviour fr: عند المشي، هل يُشعرك السلوك غير الآمن ممن يقودون أو يركبون الدراجات أو يمشون بعدم الأمان؟

de.#When you walk, does unsafe behaviour fr: Fühlen Sie sich beim Gehen durch unsicheres Verhalten von Fahrenden oder zu Fuß Gehenden unsicher?

en.#When you walk, does unsafe behaviour fr: When you walk, does unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders or pedestrians make you feel unsafe?

fa.#When you walk, does unsafe behaviour fr: هنگام پیاده‌روی، آیا رفتار ناایمن رانندگان، دوچرخه‌سواران یا عابران پیاده باعث می‌شود احساس ناامنی کنید؟

fr.#When you walk, does unsafe behaviour fr: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause de comportements dangereux de personnes qui conduisent, qui roulent ou qui marchent ?

hu.#When you walk, does unsafe behaviour fr: Gyaloglás közben a járművezetők, kerékpárosok vagy gyalogosok veszélyes viselkedése miatt érzi magát veszélyben?

it.#When you walk, does unsafe behaviour fr: Quando cammini, i comportamenti pericolosi di chi guida, di chi pedala o di chi va a piedi ti fanno sentire in pericolo?

tr.#When you walk, does unsafe behaviour fr: Yürürken sürücülerin veya yayaların güvensiz davranışları kendinizi güvensiz hissetmenize neden oluyor mu?
